meta.rca_caveat: rca_within_basket is NOT a Balassa RCA. The denominator is the country's exports of THIS TECHNOLOGY'S HS basket, not total merchandise exports, because cache/bilateral_ds holds only green-dictionary codes. Values are comparable across codes within a technology and across countries for the same code, but NOT to published Balassa RCA figures.
